summary: Reads BSP_Session_RouteMessage 0077C2A0 in full and establishes its three destinations, the session mode field shared by world+1FE4h and session+F4h, and the process-wide route-flag default at 00E0AF1C written only by 0076FAD0. Shows that a local (mode 0) session forces the flag word to 1 and delivers through 0076E520, which serialises the message into a 400h-byte stack stream and rebuilds a second message before appending it to session+24Ch; the copy is stamped with the current tick, so the drain in BSP_Session_PumpStep applies it in the same fixed step when the route ran before row 9. Establishes that there is no kind table: 00780670 sorts by message category, 00780120 is an ordered is-a ladder and 0077FE80 plus the vtable[164h] switches finish the job. Resolves kinds 58h, 5Ah, 5Eh, 99h, 4Eh and 9Ah to their receivers.

routines.name: BSP_Session_RouteMessage
routines.abi: __thiscall(entity /*ECX*/, message, int routeFlagsOverride, void** out), RET 0Ch
routines.evidence: 134 instructions from python tools/bsp.py ghidra disasm 0077c2a0. Frame: SUB ESP,0xC at 0077C2A0 then PUSH EDI/EBP/EBX/ESI, so EBP = [ESP+18h] is the message (0077C2D0), [ESP+1Ch] the override (0077C2FD) and [ESP+28h] the out pointer (0077C452). 0077C2AD spills this to [ESP+4] because 0077C3D3 ADD EDI,0x2A4 clobbers EDI; 0077C400 and 0077C436 read it back. Routing: 0077C30A CMOVNZ EBX,EAX; 0077C30D CMP EBX,4 with 0077C31D CMP [EAX+1FE4h],ESI; 0077C32F TEST EAX,EAX with 0077C333 MOV EBX,ESI forcing flags to 1 in mode 0; 0077C374 MOV BL,AL / NEG BL / SBB EBX,EBX / NEG EBX / ADD EBX,2 is the predicate ? 3 : 2 idiom.

routines.name: BSP_Session_EnqueueIncomingMessage
routines.coverage: complete for the copy and both append paths; the stream class at 00D0385C is contract: unread
routines.evidence: 0076E53F MOV EDI,[ESP+448h] is the message and 0076E5A9 MOV EDX,[ESP+44Ch] the sender for the frame depth 444h (PUSH -1/handler/FS chain = 0Ch, SUB ESP,0x428, four register pushes). 0076E561 MOV EBP,0x400 is the stack stream capacity at [ESP+38h]. The local path is a serialise/rebuild round trip, not a pointer hand-off: 0076E575 CALL EDX on message->vtable[4] then 0076E5A4 CALL 00768530. 0076E5CB MOV EDX,[EDI+0x14] copies the source message's +14h, not a peer field.

routines.name: BSP_Session_DrainMessageQueue
routines.evidence: 0076C604 loads the count at +250h and 0076C61A the base at +24Ch; 0076C639 parks the cursor at +258h and 0076C714 clears it. Status default 2 at 0076C646; 0076C662 CMP [ESP+10h],0 then 0076C678 JGE 0076C721 keeps the entry and advances (EBX = EBP), which corrects the earlier 'keep and stop' reading. 0076C6AC shifts the tail down and 0076C6DE decrements the count; 0076C6F8 CALL EDX is vtable[0](1).

routines.name: BSP_Session_DispatchQueuedMessage
routines.evidence: ECX is written at 00780681 before any read, so 0076C600's MOV CL,1 is not an input. Category ladder 47h at 0078069F, 61h at 007806EE, 49h at 00780751 selecting the 1770h window at 00780760 over the 3Ch default at 00780755, 48h at 00780797. Age limits: 0078072B CMP EAX,0xFFFFFDA8 and 007807C6 CMP EBP,-0xA with SETG/SUB/AND 2.

Switch: 0077FEAE ADD EAX,-0x53, 0077FEB1 CMP EAX,0x25, byte table at 0078005C, six targets at 00780044 (0077FFAF, 00780015, 0077FEC8, 0077FEE4, 0077FF03, 0078002F). routines.name: BSP_Session_SetMode
routines.coverage: partial: the three 00E0AF1C writes and the mode store; the per-mode teardown work is contract: unread
routines.evidence: Only writer of 00E0AF1C (get_xrefs_to 00e0af1c returns 0077C302 READ and 0076FBAF, 0076FD2C, 0076FE26 WRITE). Mode arms: 0076FB60 CMP EDI,1 with the write of 1 at 0076FBAF; 0076FCD7 CMP EDI,EBP with EBP = 2 at 0076FCD2 and the write of EBP at 0076FD2C; 0076FD71 CMP EDI,EBX (0) with the write of 1 at 0076FE26. 0076FE85 MOV [ESI+0xF4],EDI stores the new mode, the same field the router reads at world+1FE4h.

routines.evidence: 00779FF0 MOV ECX,[ESP+4] then MOV AL,[ECX+0x10]; the type comparisons are 82h, 81h, A7h, A8h, A9h, and the fallback is message->vtable[0Ch](4Ah) at 0077A010.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_ApplyEntityCommand
routines.coverage: partial: only the descriptor rebuild 00816E4B-00816EA6 was read; the rest of the 380-line body is contract: unread
routines.evidence: The seven descriptor fields come from msg+24h (word, 00816E8D), msg+26h (word, 00816E7B), msg+28h (dword, 00816E92) and the four floats at msg+2Ch..+38h. 00816E5E stores the first float to [ESP+24h] before 00816E69 PUSH EDI, so it lands at [ESP+28h] in the post-push frame and the dword store does not overwrite it; the 18h-byte copy is contiguous at [ESP+20h]. 00816E9C CALL 0077A050 resolves the ordinal byte and 00816EA6 compares the result with 00E08F60.

corrections.was: 0076E520, __thiscall(session, peer); sets msg+18h from peer+174h and msg+14h from peer+14h
corrections.is: __thiscall(session, message, sender); the queued object is a rebuilt copy, its +18h comes from sender+174h and its +14h is copied from the source message's +14h
corrections.evidence: 0077C445 PUSH EDI then 0077C446 PUSH EBP gives the argument order (message, sender). 0076E53F MOV EDI,[ESP+448h] is the message for the 444h frame depth and EDI is not written again before 0076E5CB MOV EDX,[EDI+0x14]; the sender is 0076E5A9 MOV EDX,[ESP+44Ch] and is used only at 0076E5B2 MOV AX,[EDX+0x174].

corrections.is: status 0 keeps the entry and continues with the next one; only a queue that reaches its end stops
corrections.evidence: 0076C678 JGE 0x0076C721 on the in-mission branch, 0076C721 MOV EBX,EBP advances the cursor without unlinking, and 0076C723 JMP 0x0076C6FA is the loop tail test at 0076C709.

corrections.was: 0077C2A0 read for the routing decision only; the rest is contract: unread. 00779FF0 is a message-type predicate used to pick the branch
corrections.is: the whole body is read; 00779FF0 also decides whether a client applies the message locally as well as sending it, and the flag word can be rewritten to 3 or 2 by the mode-2 branch
corrections.evidence: 0077C34B JNZ 0077C35A then OR EBX,ESI, and the 0077C374 NEG/SBB/NEG/ADD 2 sequence.
